clips.name: projects
clips.intro: Open a project and recover its current state.
clips.outro: Goal, current position, blocker and next step each link to a source.

clips.name: conversations
clips.outro: Prompt, answer and recorded output stay inside their conversation. Times include seconds and timezone.

clips.name: find
clips.outro: Results retain source links. Search does not require a generation model.

clips.name: timeline
clips.intro: Compare conversation activity across tools and dates.
clips.outro: Open a dated bucket to inspect its conversations. Messages and memories are not separate events.

clips.name: review
clips.intro: Inspect knowledge that may need correction.
clips.outro: The fixture includes contradictory and superseded statements. A suggestion is not a verified fact.

clips.name: operate
clips.intro: Understand the import and processing stages.
clips.outro: Discovery, import, extraction and embeddings have separate states. No processing is started in this clip.

clips.name: console
clips.intro: Inspect the fictional corpus with read-only SQL.
clips.outro: The query counts conversations by source tool. PostgreSQL enforces read-only execution.

clips.name: roles
clips.intro: Define the responsibility and tool for a role.
clips.outro: The demo separates analysis, execution, testing and review.

clips.name: members
clips.intro: See the people and agents available to teams.
clips.outro: These identities are invented fixtures, not real team members.

clips.name: pipelines
clips.intro: Inspect the roles and sequence in a team pipeline.
clips.outro: Team configuration is reusable across linked projects.

clips.name: models
clips.intro: Inspect provider configuration separately from project history.
clips.outro: Provider entries are fictional. This recording performs no hosted generation.

clips.name: teams
clips.intro: Connect project history with optional AI-team operations.
clips.outro: Fictional tasks show completed, blocked and running states. No agent is launched.
